inputs.reference: controlled same-content tint; plus official different-content reference

feature_policy: Masked histogram and <=512 deterministic regional samples; modified statistics, not native semantics

video.audio: first optional audio track; AAC; no shortest truncation

output_metadata.video_stream: Stream #0:0[0x1](und): Video: h264 (High) (avc1 / 0x31637661), yuv420p(tv, bt709/unknown/unknown, progressive), 640x360, 479 kb/s, 30 fps, 30 tbr, 15360 tbn (default)
output_metadata.color_management: FFmpeg normal SDR RGB decoding; native/profile equivalence unvalidated

video.padding: right/bottom black padding to even dimensions
video.frame_rate_conversion: input timeline sampled to fixed 30fps; VFR timestamps not preserved
video.color: SDR BT709 limited YUV420P; RGB8 working frames
video.encoding_loss: Lossy H264/AAC; separate from mapping fidelity

last_frame.algorithm: experimental masked feature statistics, two fixed maps, moving person alpha

limitations: Single official person clip, composited background
No multi-shot, broad skin tones or fast occlusion acceptance
Person region includes hair and clothes; reference clothing colors can bias the map
Whole background is one region, sky/trees not distinguished
Fixed maps from first target frame; moving masks, no automatic shot-wise reanalysis
No new app UI or distribution created
